## Add tests for priority icon in getIconPrefix

## Goal
Add/update tests covering the priority icon rendering in `getIconPrefix`.

## Tests to add/update
1. **Emoji rendering** — verify priority icons render correctly for all levels (critical=🚨, high=⭐, medium=📋, low=🐢)
2. **Fallback rendering** — verify `PRIORITY_FALLBACK` text is used when `noIcons: true`
3. **Null/undefined priority** — verify empty icon cell when priority is null or undefined
4. **noIcons mode** — verify entire prefix still renders correctly with noIcons when priority is present
5. **ICON_PREFIX_WIDTH** — verify new width of 13 is applied and alignment is preserved
6. **Column ordering** — verify priority icon appears as the first column before agent status

### Key Files:
- `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` or `tests/unit/icons.test.ts` — New/add tests for priority icon in `getIconPrefix`

data.comment: Implementation note: prepended the priority icon as column 0 of getIconPrefix (packages/shared/src/icons.ts) and raised ICON_PREFIX_WIDTH 12->13; stageStart offset updated so coverage dimming still targets the stage icon. Tests added to tests/herdr/icons.test.ts (emoji per level, PRIORITY_FALLBACK under noIcons, null/undefined priority, column ordering before agent slot, fixed 13-cell width, noIcons fallback) and an end-to-end assertion in packages/herdr/src/worklist-icons.test.ts (priority glyph before the item ID, ID column aligned). Existing width assertions updated 12->13 (packages/herdr/src/icons.test.ts). Two pre-existing test changes: (1) the old cross-mode width-equality test now asserts icon-mode = 13 and noIcons >= 13, because PRIORITY_FALLBACK text is wider than one glyph - alignment is a fixed minimum, not an exact cross-mode match; (2) docs/icons-design.md documents the new column layout.
